content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For Scalar Data Types, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. Bindings are immutable unless declared mut; shadowing creates a new binding. Prefer explicit conversions and clear formatting over silently assuming a numeric conversion is safe.
